item.title: Geraldton bushfires: More than 300 people gather to raise funds and show support at relief concert
item.description: The Geraldton community has come out in full force to raise thousands of dollars for bushfire victims through Friday night’s relief concert and online fundraisers.

item.title: Geraldton mother and bushfire victim Gail Holmes says kindness of fireys, community has shone through darkness
item.description: The bushfire that tore through the community last week turned life on its head for many locals, but for Gail Holmes and her eight-year-old daughter Harper it is a personal nightmare that still feels unreal.

item.title: Rematches, rivalries and reveals: Here’s how each GNFL club’s 2026 fixture is shaping up
item.description: With the 2026 GNFL fixture release imminent, sports reporter James Gardiner looked over the draw for your club, with what to expect from the fixture.

item.title: Geraldton Amateur Basketball Association hosts inaugural mental health round
item.description: The Geraldton Basketball Association is teaming up with community mental health providers to host its maiden mental health round.

item.title: Consumer Watch with Natasha Pirrottina: Quad bike safety campaign reminds that one ride can change everything
item.description: Quad bikes are not toys and the ACCC and Consumer Protection is encouraging farmers, partners, parents and carers to protect their loved ones when riding these powerful machines.

item.title: Snapshot in Time: The role Geraldton’s radar station played in World War II
item.description: Geraldton and the surrounding Mid West region became a significant defence location during World War II and remains so to this day.

item.title: Geraldton fishers face loss of livelihood over demersal commercial fishing bans
item.description: Local fishers have slammed the State Government’s permanent ban on commercial demersal fishing, saying livelihoods will be destroyed and consumers will suffer from less choice and higher prices.

item.title: All Volunteer Bushfire Brigades Are Local Legends Maiden: How Geraldton Turf Club thanked emergency services
item.description: The Geraldton Turf Club has joined an ever-growing list of community members who have paid tribute to emergency services who responded to the bushfires in Geraldton’s northen suburbs.

item.title: Geraldton Bendigo Bank Cricket League round 8: Sportsmans tighten grip at top of ladder with pair of wins
item.description: Sportsmans firmed as Geraldton Bendigo Bank Cricket League premiership favourites with two wins on the weekend.

item.title: Geraldton water polo round 8: Serpents A-grade women fall one goal short of taking it up to top team Demons
item.description: Serpents came within a whisker of upsetting ladder leaders Demons in a thrilling women’s A-grade contest, falling a goal short in one of the best matches of the season so far.
